name: Ascension
audio: a swelling choir and organ, soft chimes and a warm dragon hum; no speech
world: The sanctum is alive: rays of light shift through the windows, golden motes and incense drift, the rose window blazes and the gold-inlaid floor glimmers.

actions.beat: The great rose window behind the altar ignites and beams of golden light stream across the sanctum, incense rising through the rays.
{{She}} lifts the staff and opens {{her}} free palm to the light as a sunburst halo blazes behind {{her}} and golden feathers of light lift from {{her}} mantle.
Lumira's great wings fill the windows and glow as it lowers its head toward {{her}}, and {{she}} turns a serene, radiant look to the camera.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
